simple.meaning: עֲבֻדָּה (ʻăbuddâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “something wrought , i.e. (concretely) service.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 26:14. The surrounding context includes flock.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲבֻדָּה (H5657) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: עֲבֻדָּה (ʻăbuddâh) / H5657 is traced through Genesis 26:14, Job 1:3 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.

timeline.evidenceText: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.

His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.
